# WE10 · Chỉnh dịch vụ · lỗi

Group **WE · Ảnh, bác sĩ & phòng, dịch vụ** · state · Next.js: **planned (U4)** (`/services`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#handle`
- Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.
- `operations-data.js › updateService()` (capability `config`): refuses an empty name, a duration that is not an integer 15–180, a buffer that is not an integer 0–60 and a price that is not a non-negative safe integer. The message is shown in `#ops-error` of the dialog "Chỉnh dịch vụ".
- The reach clears "Tên dịch vụ" (`#service-name`) and presses "Lưu dịch vụ".
- Page key `services` is allowed for roles: owner (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"services\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"service\"]"} → {"wait":"#service-name"} → {"fill":["#service-name",""]} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"save-service\"]"}; it must show "Kiểm tra tên, thời lượng 15–180 phút, đệm 0–60 phút và giá không âm.".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
// opens over the page; the backdrop and the page behind it are not part of this screen
<Dialog old="modal ops-modal" eyebrow="Pema · vận hành" title="Chỉnh dịch vụ" close={{"label":"Đóng hộp thoại"}}>
  <Field label="Tên dịch vụ" type="text" id="service-name" />
  <Grid old="two-col-form" cols="1fr 1fr" gap="15px">
    <Field label="Điều trị (phút)" type="number" default="30" id="service-duration" />
    <Field label="Chuẩn bị (phút)" type="number" default="0" id="service-buffer" />
    <Field label="Giá (VND)" type="number" default="300000" id="service-price" />
    <Field label="Trạng thái" type="select" default="Đang dùng" id="service-active" options={["Đang dùng","Tạm ngưng"]} />
  </Grid>
  <Button variant="primary" old="btn btn-primary">"Lưu dịch vụ"</Button>  // ops=save-service
  <Notice tone="danger" role="alert" old="ops-error">"Kiểm tra tên, thời lượng 15–180 phút, đệm 0–60 phút và giá không âm."</Notice>
</Dialog>
```
Kit components used: Field×5, Dialog×1, Button×1; shared pieces: Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Differences from the app design
- App I9 shows the same fields (Tên dịch vụ, Điều trị (phút), Chuẩn bị (phút), Giá (VND), Trạng thái) and the notice "Lịch đã đặt giữ giá và thời lượng tại lúc đặt."; the web dialog does not carry that notice (it is the page subtitle of the services page). The error line is web-only in the specs.

## Gotchas
- The cleared dialog reads: name empty, 30, 0, 300000, "Đang dùng" (the first service); only the name is invalid.
